listing.name: Swords of Kairos v0.1 (pre-alpha)
listing.summary: Adds high-tech ships and weapons for an extinct faction of Space Knights featuring nerfed Temporal Shell systems.
listing.aiSummary: Adds high-tech ships and weapons for an extinct faction of Space Knights featuring nerfed Temporal Shell systems.

description:
Hello and welcome to my second mod:

THE SWORDS OF KAIROS (very wip!!!)

DOWNLOAD HERE!!!

I learned a lot while doing THREAT TECH, and I even gained the confidence to try my hand at making ship sprites from scratch.

After doing some testing on my own, I found them to be in a generally good spot, so I'm uploading here to hopefully get some good feedback. This is my first time actually making ships from scratch, so trying not to make these ships too strong or too weak has been quite difficult. These are by no means final editions of each ship, and I fully expect to tweak them all a lot.

Currently,

these ships/weapons are not obtainable in game without cheats

, so you will need a mod that can spawn in ships and weapons, such as

the Console Commands Mod.

All ships and weapons are prefixed with "

sok_

" so typing that in should help you find them if you don't want to look through the mod files themselves.

Very open to feedback. This is a much more ambitious mod then my last one, so I'd like to get some outside opinions.

WHAT DO THESE SHIPS/WEAPONS DO?:

SpoilerThese are high-tech ships once used by an extinct faction of noble-bright Space Knights whose primary gimmick is that they use a heavily-nerfed Temporal Shell system, are generally very quick with very strong armor that falls off with larger hull sizes (by that I mean the frigates have very high armor, but cruisers/capitals are closer to vanilla contemporaries), but typically have unimpressive shields, flux and hull.  Their ships also kinda look like swords and shields, crazy right?

Wolfpack tactics is their bread and butter; their ships are very DP expensive, so if you're the person that likes to spam large ships, this mod is not for you. Expect to use a lot of frigates and destroyers (which isn't hard, because they're very good once you give them Officers with the right skills.).

They use exclusively energy-adjacent weapons (by that I mean all their weapons are either Energy, Hybrid and Synergy) that are conveniently color coded by what role they perform; Blue is general use, Green is PD/Suppression, and Purple is Explosive Damage. You should note that their Missile Weapons are SYNERGY weapons, which means they can be mounted on ENERGY mounts of the same size. To balance this, they have a charge-up time before they actually fire, have a hefty flux cost, and are very vulnerable to PD.

Lastly, the faction has basically no capital ships. The one you see in the preview is a unique ship you will only be able to get one of. It has no gimmick beyond being a capital ship that has temporal shell (which ofc makes it very strong).[close]

WHAT ARE MY FUTURE PLANS FOR THIS MOD?:

SpoilerMaking a quick rundown of things I'd like to do:

>Add these as rare spawns as direlicts, markets, or even some base-game faction fleets, and add blueprints for constructing them.

>Add special "Regalia" versions that have exclusive hullmods that give them stat boosts that are good for any build, but can only be found as loot.

>Make a bunch of "Space Knight" portraits (there will be many chads and waifus, all hand drawn by me.).

>Add flags relating to this extinct faction of space knights so you can roleplay as Space King Arthur (in space) for your player faction.

>Make some logistics ships for this non-faction.

>A custom bounty for getting the Guinevere (aka the capital ship).

[close]

CREDITS:

SpoilerThe starsector team for this really cool game that is super easy to mod.

Nia Tahl's Tahlan Shipworks for the idea of "space knights using temporal tech" which I so shamelessly stole for my mod.

The berserk 2016 anime for the CLANG sound effect.[close]

CHANGELOG:

Spoiler

v0.1 - (05-09-2026)

initial release

[close]

aiDescription: Introduces a set of energy-adjacent ships and weapons characterized by high armor on smaller hulls and wolfpack tactics. The faction uses exclusively Energy, Hybrid, and Synergy weapons color-coded by role, with missiles requiring charge-up time. Currently, these assets are not obtainable in-game without cheats or spawning mods.
